title: Expected visits and transition probabilities
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and let $u$ and $v$ be vertices. For every $N\in\mathbb{N}$, the expected number of visits to $v$ along a uniformly chosen sequence of $N$ neighbor indices starting at $u$ equals the sum, over $j=0,\ldots,N-1$, of the probabilities that the walk is at $v$ after $j+1$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
